schema.text: Which of these situations that make you feel in danger do you come across most often on your usual routes?

options.text: Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure (e.g. crossings, cycle paths)
Sidewalks that are narrow, missing or blocked by cars or scooters
Pedestrian green light too short or traffic lights out of order
Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. potholes, debris)
Uneven or slippery surfaces, steps or risk of falling
Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, or pedestrians
Crowding or conflicts with other road users
Emergency help that is hard to call or slow to arrive
I don't feel unsafe at all

it.#Heavy or fast-moving traffic: Traffico intenso o ad alta velocità
it.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: Mancanza di infrastrutture sicure o adeguate (ad es. attraversamenti, piste ciclabili)
it.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: Comportamenti pericolosi di automobilisti, conducenti di altri veicoli o pedoni
it.#Crowding or conflicts with other road u: Affollamento o conflitti con altri utenti della strada
it.#I don't feel unsafe at all: Non mi sento affatto in pericolo
it.#Which of these situations that make you: Quali di queste situazioni, che ti fanno sentire in pericolo, incontri più spesso sui tuoi percorsi abituali?
it.#Sidewalks that are narrow, missing or b: Marciapiedi stretti, assenti o occupati da auto e monopattini
it.#Pedestrian green light too short or tra: Verde pedonale troppo breve o semafori guasti
it.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: Cattive condizioni della strada o dei percorsi (ad es. buche, detriti)
it.#Uneven or slippery surfaces, steps or r: Superfici irregolari o scivolose, gradini o rischio di cadere

fr.#Heavy or fast-moving traffic: Trafic dense ou véhicules roulant vite
fr.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: Manque d’infrastructures sûres ou adaptées (par ex. passages piétons, pistes cyclables)
fr.#Poor visibility or limited sightlines: Mauvaise visibilité ou champ de vision limité
fr.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: Comportement dangereux de conducteurs, cyclistes, usagers de deux-roues ou piétons
fr.#Crowding or conflicts with other road u: Forte affluence ou conflits avec d’autres usagers de la route
fr.#I don't feel unsafe at all: Je ne me sens jamais en danger
fr.#Which of these situations that make you: Parmi ces situations qui vous donnent un sentiment de danger, lesquelles rencontrez-vous le plus souvent sur vos itinéraires habituels ?
fr.#Sidewalks that are narrow, missing or b: Trottoirs étroits, inexistants ou encombrés par des voitures ou des trottinettes
fr.#Pedestrian green light too short or tra: Feu vert piéton trop court ou feux en panne
fr.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: Routes ou chemins en mauvais état (par ex. nids-de-poule, débris)
fr.#Uneven or slippery surfaces, steps or r: Surfaces irrégulières ou glissantes, marches ou risque de chute
fr.#Emergency help that is hard to call or: Secours difficiles à appeler ou lents à arriver

de.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: Fehlende sichere oder geeignete Infrastruktur (z. B. Übergänge, Radwege)
de.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: Gefährliches Verhalten von Autofahrern, Zweiradfahrern oder Fußgängern
de.#Crowding or conflicts with other road u: Überfüllung oder Konflikte mit anderen Verkehrsteilnehmenden
de.#I don't feel unsafe at all: Ich fühle mich überhaupt nicht gefährdet
de.#Which of these situations that make you: Welche dieser Situationen, bei denen Sie sich in Gefahr fühlen, erleben Sie auf Ihren üblichen Wegen am häufigsten?
de.#Sidewalks that are narrow, missing or b: Schmale, fehlende oder durch Autos oder E-Scooter blockierte Gehwege
de.#Pedestrian green light too short or tra: Zu kurze Fußgängergrünphase oder defekte Ampeln
de.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: Schlechter Zustand von Straßen oder Wegen (z. B. Schlaglöcher, Schmutz)
de.#Uneven or slippery surfaces, steps or r: Unebene oder rutschige Oberflächen, Stufen oder Sturzgefahr
de.#Emergency help that is hard to call or: Hilfe im Notfall ist schwer zu rufen oder kommt spät

tr.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: Güvenli veya yeterli altyapı eksikliği (örneğin yaya geçitleri, bisiklet yolları)
tr.#Poor visibility or limited sightlines: Kötü görüş veya sınırlı görüş mesafesi
tr.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: Sürücülerin, iki tekerlekli araç kullanıcılarının veya yayaların tehlikeli davranışları
tr.#Crowding or conflicts with other road u: Kalabalık veya diğer yol kullanıcılarıyla çatışma
tr.#Which of these situations that make you: Kendinizi tehlikede hissettiren bu durumlardan hangileriyle olağan güzergâhlarınızda en sık karşılaşıyorsunuz?
tr.#Sidewalks that are narrow, missing or b: Dar, olmayan veya otomobil ya da skuterlerle kapatılmış kaldırımlar
tr.#Pedestrian green light too short or tra: Yayalar için yeşil ışığın çok kısa olması veya bozuk trafik ışıkları
tr.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: Yol veya patikaların kötü durumda olması (ör. çukurlar, moloz)
tr.#Uneven or slippery surfaces, steps or r: Düzensiz veya kaygan zeminler, basamaklar veya düşme riski
tr.#Emergency help that is hard to call or: Acil yardımı çağırmanın zor olması veya geç gelmesi

fa.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: نبود زیرساخت ایمن یا مناسب (مثلاً گذرگاه عابر پیاده، مسیر دوچرخه)
fa.#Poor visibility or limited sightlines: دید ضعیف یا میدان دید محدود
fa.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: رفتار خطرناک رانندگان، موتورسواران، دوچرخه‌سواران یا عابران
fa.#Crowding or conflicts with other road u: شلوغی یا برخورد و تعارض با سایر کاربران راه
fa.#Which of these situations that make you: کدام‌یک از این موقعیت‌ها که باعث می‌شوند احساس خطر کنید، بیشتر در مسیرهای معمول شما پیش می‌آید؟
fa.#Sidewalks that are narrow, missing or b: پیاده‌روهای باریک، ناموجود یا اشغال‌شده با خودرو یا اسکوتر
fa.#Pedestrian green light too short or tra: چراغ سبز عابر پیاده خیلی کوتاه یا چراغ‌های راهنمایی خراب
fa.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: وضعیت نامناسب خیابان یا مسیر (مثلاً چاله، زباله)
fa.#Uneven or slippery surfaces, steps or r: سطوح ناهموار یا لغزنده، پله یا خطر زمین خوردن
fa.#Emergency help that is hard to call or: کمک اضطراری که تماس با آن دشوار است یا دیر می‌رسد

hu.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: Biztonságos vagy megfelelő infrastruktúra hiánya (például átkelőhelyek, kerékpárutak)
hu.#Poor visibility or limited sightlines: Rossz látási viszonyok vagy korlátozott beláthatóság
hu.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: Járművezetők, kétkerekű járművek használói vagy gyalogosok veszélyes viselkedése
hu.#Which of these situations that make you: Melyek azok a veszélyérzetet keltő helyzetek, amelyekkel a szokásos útvonalain a leggyakrabban találkozik?
hu.#Sidewalks that are narrow, missing or b: Keskeny, hiányzó vagy autókkal, rollerekkel elfoglalt járdák
hu.#Pedestrian green light too short or tra: Túl rövid gyalogos zöld jelzés vagy nem működő közlekedési lámpák
hu.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: Rossz út- vagy járdaviszonyok (pl. kátyúk, törmelék)
hu.#Uneven or slippery surfaces, steps or r: Egyenetlen vagy csúszós felületek, lépcsőfokok vagy elesés veszélye
hu.#Emergency help that is hard to call or: Nehezen hívható vagy lassan érkező segítség vészhelyzetben

ar.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: نقص البنية التحتية الآمنة أو المناسبة (مثل المعابر ومسارات الدراجات)
ar.#Poor visibility or limited sightlines: ضعف الرؤية أو محدودية مجال النظر
ar.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: سلوك خطير من السائقين أو مستخدمي المركبات ذات العجلتين أو المشاة
ar.#Crowding or conflicts with other road u: الازدحام أو التعارض مع مستخدمي الطريق الآخرين
ar.#Which of these situations that make you: أي من هذه المواقف التي تجعلك تشعر بالخطر تصادفها أكثر من غيرها في مساراتك المعتادة؟
ar.#Sidewalks that are narrow, missing or b: أرصفة ضيقة أو غير موجودة أو تسدها السيارات أو السكوترات
ar.#Pedestrian green light too short or tra: إشارة المشاة الخضراء قصيرة جدًا أو إشارات مرور معطلة
ar.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: سوء حالة الطريق أو المسار (مثل الحفر أو المخلفات)
ar.#Uneven or slippery surfaces, steps or r: أسطح غير مستوية أو زلقة أو درجات أو خطر السقوط
ar.#Emergency help that is hard to call or: صعوبة طلب المساعدة الطارئة أو تأخر وصولها
